text_en: At that time the Lord said to me, “Carve out two tablets of stone like the former ones, and come up to me on the mountain, and make an ark of wood.
text_cn: 那时上主对我说：“你再凿两块石版，与先前的一样，然后上山到我跟前来；还要做一个木柜。

text_en: I will write on the tablets the words that were on the former tablets, which you smashed, and you shall put them in the ark. ”
text_cn: 我要把你先前摔碎的那两块版上的话，写在这两块版上。你要将这两块石版放在柜里。”

text_en: So I made an ark of acacia wood, cut two tablets of stone like the former ones, and went up the mountain with the two tablets in my hand.
text_cn: 我于是做了一个皂荚木柜，凿了两块与先前一样的石版，手里拿着这两块石版上山去了。

text_en: Then he wrote on the tablets the same words as before, the ten commandments that the Lord had spoken to you on the mountain out of the fire on the day of the assembly; and the Lord gave them to me.
text_cn: 上主将先前所写的，即在集会之日，在山上由火中对你们所说的那十句话，写在这两块版上，交给了我。

text_en: So I turned and came down from the mountain, and put the tablets in the ark that I had made; and there they are, as the Lord commanded me.
text_cn: 我遂转身下山，照上主吩咐我的，将版放在我做的柜内，存在那里。

text_en: (The Israelites journeyed from Beeroth-bene-jaakan to Moserah. There Aaron died, and there he was buried; his son Eleazar succeeded him as priest.
text_cn: 以色列子民由贝洛特贝乃雅干起程，到了摩色辣，亚郎在那里死了，也埋在那里；他的儿子厄肋阿匝尔继他做了大司祭。

text_en: From there they journeyed to Gudgodah, and from Gudgodah to Jotbathah, a land with flowing streams.
text_cn: 又从那里起程，到了古德哥达，又从古德哥达到了多溪水之地约特巴达。

text_en: At that time the Lord set apart the tribe of Levi to carry the ark of the covenant of the Lord , to stand before the Lord to minister to him, and to bless in his name, to this day.
text_cn: 那时，上主选拔了肋未支派，叫他们抬上主的约柜，侍立在上主面前事奉他，并奉他的名祝福，直到今日。

text_en: Therefore Levi has no allotment or inheritance with his kindred; the Lord is his inheritance, as the Lord your God promised him. )
text_cn: 为此，肋未人同自己的兄弟没有分得产业，因为照上主你的天主对他们所说的：上主自己是他们的产业。

text_en: I stayed on the mountain forty days and forty nights, as I had done the first time. And once again the Lord listened to me. The Lord was unwilling to destroy you.
text_cn: 我如先前一样，在山上逗留了四十天四十夜；上主这一次又俯听了我，放弃了消灭你的意思。

text_en: The Lord said to me, “Get up, go on your journey at the head of the people, that they may go in and occupy the land that I swore to their ancestors to give them. ”
text_cn: 上主且对我说：“起来，在人民前面领路，叫他们去占领我对他们祖先誓许要赐给他们的地方。”

text_en: So now, O Israel, what does the Lord your God require of you? Only to fear the Lord your God, to walk in all his ways, to love him, to serve the Lord your God with all your heart and with all your soul,
text_cn: 以色列！现今上主你的天主向你要求什么？是要求你敬畏上主你的天主，履行他的一切道路，爱他，全心全灵事奉上主你的天主，

text_en: and to keep the commandments of the Lord your God and his decrees that I am commanding you today, for your own well-being.
text_cn: 遵守我今天吩咐你的天主的诫命和法令，好使你能获得幸福。

text_en: Although heaven and the heaven of heavens belong to the Lord your God, the earth with all that is in it,
text_cn: 看天与天上的天，地和地上的一切，都属于上主你的天主；

text_en: yet the Lord set his heart in love on your ancestors alone and chose you, their descendants after them, out of all the peoples, as it is today.
text_cn: 但上主只喜欢了你的祖先，钟爱他们，由万民中拣选了他们的后裔，就是你们，正如你们今日所见的一样。

text_en: Circumcise, then, the foreskin of your heart, and do not be stubborn any longer.
text_cn: 为此，你们要心受割损，不要再执拗，

text_en: For the Lord your God is God of gods and Lord of lords, the great God, mighty and awesome, who is not partial and takes no bribe,
text_cn: 因为上主你们的天主是万神之神，万主之主，伟大、有力、可畏的天主，是不顾情面，不受贿赂，

text_en: who executes justice for the orphan and the widow, and who loves the strangers, providing them food and clothing.
text_cn: 为孤儿、寡妇主持正义，友爱外方人，供给他们食粮和衣服的天主。

text_en: You shall also love the stranger, for you were strangers in the land of Egypt.
text_cn: 为此，你们也应友爱外方人，因为你们在埃及也曾做过外方人。

text_en: You shall fear the Lord your God; him alone you shall worship; to him you shall hold fast, and by his name you shall swear.
text_cn: 你应敬畏上主你的天主，事奉依赖他，奉他的名起誓。

text_en: He is your praise; he is your God, who has done for you these great and awesome things that your own eyes have seen.
text_cn: 他是你的光荣，是你的天主，是他为你做了你亲眼所见的奇异可畏的事。

text_en: Your ancestors went down to Egypt seventy persons; and now the Lord your God has made you as numerous as the stars in heaven.
text_cn: 你的祖先下到埃及时，总共不过七十人，现在上主你的天主却使你多得有如天上的繁星。
